Azel - Panzer Dragoon RPG.name: Panzer Dragoon Saga
Azel - Panzer Dragoon RPG.summary: Enter the world of Panzer Dragoon Saga and experience a game like no other: a fusion of classic Panzer action with the most technologically advanced RPG to come to Saturn. Board your morphing dragon and behold as the mysteries of the Panzer world unfurl across four massive CDs. The new "rail free" 3D engine lets you soar deeper into role-playing adventure than you ever before imagined. Your destiny awaits.

Dynamite Deka.name: Dynamite Deka
Dynamite Deka.summary: A version of Die Hard Arcade without the Die Hard license. This version would later be part of an original series.

Gran Chaser.name: Cyber Speedway
Gran Chaser.summary:
Cyber Speedway (Gran Chaser in Japan) is a 1995 racing video game developed by NexTech and published by Sega for the Sega Saturn.

It is a spiritual sequel to 1993 computer game CyberRace, as both games have a similar theme, and vehicles designed by Syd Mead

Shinouken.name: Ragnagard
Shinouken.summary: Ragnagard is 2D arcade fighting game developed by Saurus and System Vision, and published by SNK and Saurus for the Neo Geo arcade, Neo Geo CD and Sega Saturn. The game's characters are all based on Shinto deities
